$comment: Public summaries of the Company in a Box Modules, cited by the maurice-diagnostic Skill. Keys must match company-in-a-box-modules/modules.json. Organisation bricks only: no business-specific pack.

cib-enterprise-admin.summary: Bounded administration of people, existing identities, access per department and revocation of mandates.
cib-enterprise-admin.use_when: Directory, roles and per-department rights are rebuilt by hand around internal tools.

cib-work-dossiers.summary: Shared case files: goal, owner, references, next action, blocker and internal closing proof; management sees only the files each person may access.
cib-work-dossiers.use_when: Teams track shared files or cases in spreadsheets or ad hoc tables.

company-memory.summary: Company memory: capture of sources, proposals, manual review, cited consultation and indexing for search.
company-memory.use_when: Knowledge lives in scattered documents and answers must cite reviewed sources.

cib-daily-routine.summary: Daily routine: prepares the day's context, consults a chosen memory revision, reviews a file and records declared active time.
cib-daily-routine.use_when: People start each day by gathering the same context by hand.

cib-marketing-launch.summary: Launch marketing journey: campaign, content, trial request, follow-up and first confirmed result.
cib-marketing-launch.use_when: A launch is run through scattered scripts, forms and spreadsheets.

cib-veille.summary: Manual watch: explicit import of sources and facts, manual assignment, field and freshness checks.
cib-veille.use_when: Scripts import and sort sources for a watch or monitoring activity.

cib-contenu.summary: Content role: save, share and review content drafts with completion checks.
cib-contenu.use_when: Content drafts move between people without a shared review step.

cib-accompagnement.summary: Customer follow-up role: save and share follow-up files, with guarded actions.
cib-accompagnement.use_when: Follow-up of customers or users is tracked by hand.

cib-veille-memory.summary: Connects the watch role to company memory: search, consult and propose a selected extract.

cib-contenu-memory.summary: Connects the content role to company memory, including a draft prepared from a validated, cited revision.

cib-accompagnement-memory.summary: Connects the follow-up role to company memory: search, consult and propose a selected extract.
